vc_checking.summary: All three target witnesses are semantically proofable. The entailment witness splits a preserved circular-list representation at the distinguished node. Both return witnesses select their full-resource first disjunct, obtain the return-value equation from the suffix segment boundary, and recompose the unchanged list. A group-local split/recompose helper family is likely useful; no annotation or seed-spec change is required.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Select the first disjunct. Open xizi_dll to obtain first and last, then induct over nodes_before in the underlying xizi_dllseg. At the distinguished list element, expose its next pointer and predecessor; instantiate first/last from the opened sentinel and node_next/node_prev from the split point.
witnesses.space_plan: Apply a proved xizi_dll split-at-node helper to the single precondition resource, then unfold xizi_dll_links/XiziDLL.links so its four link fields and two segments match the generated postcondition exactly.
witnesses.pure_plan: The helper induction uses linklist_node_pre <> 0 for the distinguished non-null node; the nonempty branches of xizi_dllseg provide expected-node equality and node <> stop. List associativity/simplification rewrites nodes_before ++ linklist_node_pre :: nodes_after at each induction step.
witnesses.refinement_plan: not applicable; this is a direct spatial representation entailment

All sentinel, prefix, node-link, and suffix resources are partitions of the original xizi_dll resource; no frame is invented.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Select the first disjunct. Substitute node_next = linklist_pre. A segment whose start already equals its stop can only carry nil, so nodes_after = nil and the case-specific value function reduces to 0. Recompose the sentinel links, prefix segment, distinguished-node links, and empty suffix into the original xizi_dll.

witnesses.pure_plan: After substituting PreH1, destruct nodes_after and unfold xizi_dllseg/XiziDLL.dllseg. The cons branch contains node_next <> linklist_pre and contradicts equality; the nil branch makes xizi_double_link_next_rec_last_value nil = 0 by reflexivity. Any non-null/distinct-node facts needed while folding follow from the satisfiable separated sentinel and node link resources; equality would overlap identical field cells.
witnesses.refinement_plan: not applicable; this is a direct spatial/pure entailment

analysis_groups.shared_proof_pattern: Expose or rebuild the same circular doubly linked list at one distinguished middle node; return cases additionally reduce the suffix observation at the stop/non-stop boundary.
analysis_groups.shared_space_plan: Use one proved split/recompose helper family over xizi_dll_links and xizi_dllseg, unfolding link pairs only at the generated-VC boundary.
analysis_groups.shared_pure_plan: Use node <> NULL for the forward split, node_next = head to force an empty suffix, and node_next <> head plus xizi_dllseg_unfold to force a nonempty suffix.
analysis_groups.grouping_reason: All three witnesses are from the same straight-line function and share one tightly coupled middle-segment helper family. Keeping them together avoids duplicate helpers; count 3 is below the controller maximum 12.

proof_groups.proof_strategy: Prove a group-suffixed split/recompose helper pair by induction on nodes_before. Use the split direction for entail_wit_1. For each return witness select the full-resource first disjunct, derive the suffix-value equation by the xizi_dllseg stop boundary (equal means nil; unequal means node_next :: tail), and apply the recomposition direction without changing resources.
proof_groups.grouping_reason: All three witnesses share the same function, same xizi_dll/xizi_dllseg middle-node decomposition, and the same two-helper family; a single 3-witness group is minimal and is within max_witnesses_per_group=12.
